sources.snippet: MiniMax-H3-Fun-Controlnet-Union MiniMax-H3-Fun-Controlnet-Union is a ControlNet-Union for MiniMax-H3, trained with the VideoX-Fun pipeline. A single checkpoint conditions the MiniMax-H3 video generator on Canny, Depth, HED, MLSD or Pose control videos, and also runs video inpainting. Model Card
